learning_outcomes.text: Learns and applies the subject of strain measurements
Learns and applies the stress-strain relations
Develops application-oriented approaches to engineering problems

syllabus_topics: Introduction and repetition of the stress analysis

Applications of constant voltage potentiometer circuits
Wheatstone bridge; quarter bridge, half bridge
Strain gauge rosette and their application areas
